rci1_using_msad.detail: Multi-site; data aggregated from 5 distinct studies (HBN [4 NYC-area sites], MIPDB, ABCCT, femaleASD, LausanneASD [Lausanne, Switzerland])
rci1_using_msad.supporting_text: "The data were aggregated from five distinct studies: the Healthy Brain Network Dataset (HBN) [...], Multimodal Resource for Studying Information Processing in the Developing Brain (MIPDB) [...], Autism Biomarker Consortium for Clinical Trials Dataset (ABCCT) [...], Multimodal Developmental Neurogenetics of Females with ASD (femaleASD) [...], and LausanneASD."

rci2_using_epd.detail: HBN (Healthy Brain Network) used as one of the five data sources for NM reference cohort
rci2_using_epd.supporting_text: "The data were aggregated from five distinct studies: the Healthy Brain Network Dataset (HBN) [43, 44] (https://fcon_1000.projects.nitrc.org/indi/cmi_healthy_brain_network/MRI_EEG.html)"

rci3_epd_name.detail: HBN (Healthy Brain Network Dataset) is the only EPD from the confirmed list among the five datasets used; MIPDB, ABCCT, femaleASD, LausanneASD are not in the EPD list
rci3_epd_name.supporting_text: "The data were aggregated from five distinct studies: the Healthy Brain Network Dataset (HBN) [43, 44]"

rci5_n.detail: Training phase HC; both spectral and connectivity models trained on the same 448 HC training set (112 HC held out for testing)
rci5_n.supporting_text: "Models were trained on 448 (52% M) healthy controls (HC) and 112 (55% M) healthy subjects were held out as a comparison group against the clinical cohort."

rci6_sex.detail: Training phase; paper reports '52% M' for 448 HC training set; male_n estimated as round(448 × 0.52) = 233; female_n estimated as 448 - 233 = 215; female_pct = 215/448 ≈ 48.0%
rci6_sex.supporting_text: "Models were trained on 448 (52% M) healthy controls (HC)"

rci7_age.detail: Training phase; age mean and SD not reported separately for the 448 HC training set (overall cohort mean = 9.99 ± 3.06 covers all 2234 subjects including patients); age range 5-18 inferred from cohort restriction; age in years
rci7_age.supporting_text: "Subjects included in this study were aged between 5 and 18 years old (mean = 9.99 ± 3.06; 45% M, Fig. S1)" ; "Following preprocessing and feature extraction, the cohort was restricted to participants aged 5 to 18 years."
